# keyverse

> Pack format for OSIS-addressed scripture notes. Frictionlessness > portability > permanence.
> The pack directory is the product; the HTTP door is an optional access surface.
> Mobile (Expo RN) is the product client; web door is the multipack mirror.

## Agents & deploy

- Agent conventions: AGENTS.md
- Host (Railway) + iOS TestFlight: docs/DEPLOY.md
- TestFlight short path: mobile/docs/TESTFLIGHT.md
- Host hardening: docs/PRODUCTION.md · self-host: docs/SELF_HOST.md

## Protocol

- Name: `keyverse`
- Version: `0.2` (demo-era; expect breaking refinements before 1.0)
- Normative: PROTOCOL.md
- Layers: pack core vs door profiles (docs/adr/0014)
- Ownership: docs/OWNERSHIP.md (export/import zip)
- HTTP matrix: docs/API.md
- Schemas: schemas/ (note, attachment, cipher, protocol)
- Conformance: protocol/fixtures + `mix keyverse.conformance`
- Manifest: pack/protocol.json → `{"protocol":"keyverse","version":"0.2"}`
- Discovery: GET /{door}/api/protocol

## Preferred integration: pack filesystem

Multipack host root (`PACK_DIR`, default `./packs`):

```
packs/
  {multiword-key}/        # one pack per key
    protocol.json
    door                  # same key (optional)
    notes/<slug>.json
    attachments/<sha256>
  _cache/text/bsb/        # shared disposable scripture cache
```

Single pack (offline / import) is just that inner directory.

- Address = canonical OSIS lowercased (slug). Example: John 3:16 → `JHN.3.16` → `jhn.3.16`.
- Scope kinds: `verse` | `range` (same-chapter in v0.1) | `chapter`.
- Note body: flat `blocks[]` of `{id, indent, text, collapsed?}`. Tree is projected from indent.
- Legacy `body` string: hydrate to one block per line (indent = leading spaces / 2).
- Attachments: `kind: file` (sha256 CAS) or `kind: url` (http/https).
- Encryption (optional): `{encrypted:true, cipher:{v,alg,kdf,iter,salt,iv,ct}}`; blocks/attachments empty on disk.
- Cipher plaintext is UTF-8 JSON `{"blocks":[…],"attachments":[…]}` (AES-256-GCM, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA-256, 210000 iter).
- Containment is computed from OSIS geometry — never merge/copy note bodies between addresses.
- Passage share (door UX): default deep link is `/{door}/read/{slug}` (projected reader). Pack share is `/{door}/`. Knowing either URL is full pack access (no capability tokens in v0.2). See docs/adr/0019.
- Mobile cloud mirror: local delete wins until door empty-PUT confirmed (pending tombstones; no stale quietSync re-push). See docs/adr/0021.

## HTTP door (optional)

`/{door}/…` selects the pack for that multiword key (create at `/setup`).  
`DOOR_OPEN=1` uses one shared pack with no prefix (demo only).

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|--------|------|---------|
| GET | /api/protocol | Version + features |
| GET | /api/notes | All notes (updated_at desc) |
| GET | /api/resolve?q= | Human ref → `{kind,osis,slug}` |
| GET | /api/suggest?q=&limit= | Passage autocomplete |
| GET | /api/md/`<slug>` | Raw Markdown: chapter BSB + notes (verse expands to chapter) |
| GET | /api/note/`<slug>` | Note JSON; `?raw` → text/plain (409 if sealed) |
| PUT | /api/note/`<slug>` | Create/update/delete/seal |
| POST | /api/note/`<slug>`/attachments | URL JSON or raw file (`X-Filename`) |
| DELETE | /api/note/`<slug>`/attachments/`<id>` | Detach; optional `?sha256=` GC |
| GET | /api/attachments/`<sha256>` | Blob bytes |
| GET | /api/pack | Pack manifest (user-owned counts) |
| GET | /api/pack/export | Zip export (notes+attachments only) |
| POST | /api/pack/import | Zip import (`mode=merge|replace`) |
| GET | /api/share-qr?origin=&path= | Door or deep-link SVG QR (`path` = `/`, `/note|read/<slug>`) |
| OPTIONS | /api/* | CORS preflight → 204 |
| GET | /sw.js | Service worker (root; PWA) |
| GET | /manifest.webmanifest | Web app manifest |
| GET | /icons/* | App icons |
| GET | /offline | Offline fallback HTML |

### PUT bodies

- `text/plain` (or non-JSON): interchange text, 2 spaces = one indent. Empty → delete if no attachments.
- `application/json` `{ "blocks":[…], "attachments"?: […] }` — omit attachments to preserve.
- `application/json` `{ "encrypted": true, "cipher": {…} }` — seal.

### CORS

Default `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` on `/api/*`. Set `CORS_ORIGIN=off` to disable, or a comma-list of origins. Access control = knowing the door URL.

## Must

- Normalize human references before write (grab-bcv or GET /api/resolve).
- Preserve surviving `blocks[].id` across edits.
- Preserve `attachments` when only updating blocks (omit key on PUT).
- Treat empty plaintext + no attachments as delete.
- Ignore unknown JSON keys.
- Keep passphrase client-side only (never send to server).
- User owns pack data; export zip must omit disposable scripture cache.
- Validate packs offline when possible (`mix keyverse.conformance` / schemas).

## Must not

- Absorb or reparent notes by containment.
- Treat `text/` as user data.
- Assume multi-writer merge / sync (undefined in v0.1).
- Expect attachment *bytes* to be passphrase-encrypted (only note metadata is sealed).

## Docs map

- PROTOCOL.md — pack + door normative rules
- docs/API.md — HTTP status/body matrix
- docs/USAGE.md — human UI
- docs/SELF_HOST.md — run/env/backup

- README.md — quick start + curl

## Example curl

```sh
DOOR=your-four-word-key
BASE="http://localhost:4180/$DOOR"
curl -s "$BASE/api/protocol"
curl -s "$BASE/api/resolve?q=John+3:16"
curl -s -X PUT "$BASE/api/note/jhn.3.16" -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"blocks":[{"id":"b1","indent":0,"text":"See [[John 3:17]]."}]}'
```
